run_update_data: run the update_data function to transform FILL action triples into schematics format for all files in a folder
run_cli_migration: run the script with --input_folder to migrate Droidlet dataset files to the new schematics format
update_fill_actions: update FILL actions in HUMAN_GIVE_COMMAND dialogue entries by moving triples into a schematics filters structure
batch_transform_dataset: batch transform all text files in a folder by rewriting action sequences and writing output to new files
validate_output_updates: validate the output files after transformation to confirm no remaining triples need updating
